investigation_question: Are SplitCriteria enum values available in DllReflector catalog for Aspose.Words.LowCode namespace?
finding: SplitCriteria enum does not appear in the Words api-catalog. The catalog contains the Splitter class with ExtractPages, RemoveBlankPages, Split methods, but the SplitCriteria enum values are not reflected.
root_cause: DllReflector reflects public methods but does not enumerate parameter enum values. SplitCriteria is a parameter type for Splitter.Split(SplitCriteria, ...) but its enum values (ByPage, BySection, ByHeading, etc.) are not in the catalog.
impact: The Splitter scenario uses ExtractPages (which takes page indices, not enum) and is PUBLISHED. The Split(SplitCriteria) overload cannot be used without knowing enum values.
recommendation: words-splitter is PUBLISHED using ExtractPages (page-index based) — not blocked. SplitCriteria is only needed for the Split() overload which is a secondary method. The open taskcard followup-words-split-criteria-enumeration tracks adding Split() demonstration as an enhancement, not a blocker.
conclusion: words-splitter example is COMPLETE as published. followup-words-split-criteria-enumeration is enhancement-only.
blocking_status: NON_BLOCKING — existing example uses ExtractPages which works without SplitCriteria
